Preceded by Kollasuyu integrated into Inca Empire — southernmost quarter of Tawantinsuyu and Pachacuti defeats the Colla kingdom c. 1450. Their legacy influenced Potosí founded — grows to become one of the world's largest cities and Inca Empire.
